gui.bobbypipes.autocraft_monitor.unlinke: Place next to a smart pipe
gui.bobbypipes.crafting.import.tip: Copy the pattern from an adjacent Pattern Table

gui.bobbypipes.request.missing.title: Missing items
gui.bobbypipes.satellite.name: Satellite name
gui.bobbypipes.help.basic_pipe: Basic routed pipe. Can be marked as the network default route so leftover items have somewhere to go.
gui.bobbypipes.help.provider_pipe: Offers adjacent inventory stock to the network. Empty filter provides everything. Whitelist provides only listed items; blacklist provides everything except listed items. Leave modes keep stacks back in the attached inventory.
gui.bobbypipes.provider.whitelist.tip: Only listed items are provided. An empty filter provides everything.
gui.bobbypipes.provider.blacklist.tip: Everything except listed items is provided. An empty filter provides everything.
gui.bobbypipes.provider.leave.normal.tip: Provide every extractable item in the attached inventory.
gui.bobbypipes.provider.leave.leave_firs: In each attached inventory, never take from the first occupied slot (scan order). Other stacks are still provided.
gui.bobbypipes.provider.leave.leave_last: In each attached inventory, never take from the last occupied slot (scan order). Other stacks are still provided.
gui.bobbypipes.provider.leave.leave_firs: In each attached inventory, never take from the first or last occupied slot. Middle stacks are still provided.
gui.bobbypipes.provider.leave.leave_one_: Keep one item in every stack of each attached inventory.
gui.bobbypipes.help.crafting_pipe: Autocrafts from a pattern. Ingredients are pulled from the network; the rightmost column can deliver to a named satellite buffer.
gui.bobbypipes.help.satellite_pipe: Names an adjacent inventory as a crafting satellite so crafting pipes can send selected ingredients there.
gui.bobbypipes.help.supplier_pipe: Keeps the adjacent inventory stocked to the configured targets by requesting missing items from the network.
gui.bobbypipes.help.passive_supplier_pip: Publishes stock targets as standing demand. Spare items already on the network will land here before a default route.
gui.bobbypipes.help.request_pipe: Browse network stock and craftables, then request deliveries to this pipe.
gui.bobbypipes.help.energy_request: Enter an amount of FE and request it from energy providers on the network.
gui.bobbypipes.help.energy_supplier_pipe: Set a target FE amount; this pipe keeps its attached energy storage filled to it.
gui.bobbypipes.help.fluid_request: Pick a fluid and an amount, then request it from fluid providers on the network.
gui.bobbypipes.help.fluid_supplier_pipe: Pick a target fluid and amount; this pipe keeps its attached tank filled to it.
item.bobbypipes.wrench.tip: Right click a pipe to open its settings
item.bobbypipes.pipe_goggles.tip: Wear on your head to see live status of the pipe you look at
gui.bobbypipes.help.link_pipe: Pairs with exactly one other Link Pipe on the same channel. When both ends are loaded, the network treats them as one adjacent pipe hop - even across dimensions. If a peer chunk unloads, the link severs until it loads again; the channel stays claimed.
gui.bobbypipes.help.chunk_loader: Creative chunk loader. Sets how many chunks away from this block stay force-loaded (Chebyshev distance). Debug outlines draw client-side wireframes around chunks that are actually loaded in that radius.
